channel.title: Claude Platform release notes
channel.description: Updates to the Claude Platform, including the Claude API, client SDKs, and the Claude Console.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 23, 2026
item.description:
• A fix is live for an undercount of web searches in the List User Activity endpoint of the Claude Enterprise Analytics API. The top-level web_search_count did not count every search tool that Claude uses in chats, so it left out some searches. It now includes them, so it can be higher. Most of the added searches come from Chat and Cowork unified.
  • The web search fix applies to data for November 17, 2026 (UTC), and later, so counts that you already pulled for those days can change. It does not recount earlier days.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 23, 2026
item.description:
• A fix is live for an undercount in the Get Connector Usage endpoint of the Claude Enterprise Analytics API. In chats that the session counting change reached, individual_auth_distinct_user_count and managed_auth_distinct_user_count left out users who used a connector. For most organizations, these counts now include most of those users. They can be higher, and can show a number where they used to be null.
  • The connector fix applies to data for November 19, 2026 (UTC), and later, so counts that you already pulled for those days can change. It does not recount earlier days.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 23, 2026
item.description:
• On November 24, 2026, a fix for an undercount of project activity in the Claude Enterprise Analytics API will go live. The Get Chat Project Usage endpoint leaves out some messages in project chats. One example is messages sent after a chat moves into a Cowork cloud session. After the fix, it will count most of those messages. message_count, distinct_conversation_count, and distinct_user_count can then be higher, and more projects can appear in the results.
  • The List User Activity endpoint will change in the same way when you filter by project_id. message_count and distinct_conversation_count can be higher, last_activity_date can be later, and more users can appear. Without the filter, some of these messages count in chat_cowork_unified_metrics.sessions.message_count. So the chat message_count for a user can be higher with the filter than without it.
  • The project fix will apply to data for November 20, 2026 (UTC), and later, so counts that you already pulled for those days can change. It does not recount earlier days.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 23, 2026
item.description: • We announced the deprecation of the Claude Opus 4.5 model (claude-opus-4-5-20251101 and claude-opus-4-5), with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for January 22, 2027. We recommend migrating to Claude Opus 5.5. See Migrating from Claude Opus 4.5 or earlier. To check which dates apply on other platforms, see Model deprecations.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 23, 2026
item.description: • We’ve launched Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) in beta on Claude Platform, Claude Platform on AWS, and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed). EFS is Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for eligible organizations that use Claude’s most capable models. Anthropic doesn’t retain your prompts and responses. Encrypted copies of them, called Sealed Safety Data, go to a bucket in your own cloud account. A workspace on Anthropic-managed storage isn’t on EFS, because Anthropic stores that workspace’s Sealed Safety Data. To get access, see Setup guide.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 23, 2026
item.description: • We’ve added two event types to organization webhooks, which are in beta. We send external_storage.failed when a bucket that you use as customer-owned storage fails our daily check, and external_storage.recovered when it passes again.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 17, 2026
item.description: • We’ve launched Linked billing in beta with the user-profiles-billing-2026-10-01 beta header. Your customers can now pay for the Claude usage in your app through their own Claude organization. Once a customer links their organization, set billing_policy on each /v1/messages or /v1/chat/completions request to choose who pays. In the Claude Console, customers can set a spend cap for your app or unlink your app. Linked billing works for customers whose organization pays Anthropic directly for API usage.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 16, 2026
item.description: • Text generated by Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5 carries Anthropic’s text watermark on supported platforms. How Claude marks AI-generated content lists those platforms. If a request to one of these models sets temperature, top_p, or top_k to a non-default value, the text might not carry the watermark. See Text watermark.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 16, 2026
item.description: • We’ve added two event types to organization webhooks, which are in beta. We send external_key.failed when your key management service keeps refusing a customer-managed encryption key, and external_key.recovered when the key works again.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 12, 2026
item.description: • We’ve launched self-hosted Claude Managed Agents. You run the whole Managed Agents service, not only self-hosted sandboxes, on your own infrastructure, and you store agents, sessions, and session history there. The server sends model requests to the provider that you choose, which is Anthropic by default. To request access, contact your Anthropic account team.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 9, 2026
item.description: • Dreams (research preview) now supports Claude Fable 5.2. See Supported models.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 9, 2026
item.description: • We’ve launched fast mode for Claude Fable 5.2 in Messages API requests on the Claude API. Fast mode delivers up to 2.5x higher output tokens per second, at $16 USD per MTok of input and $80 USD per MTok of output. Set speed: "fast" on your request, with no beta header.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — October 21, 2026
item.description:
• We’ve released API version 2026-10-21. Migrating to API version 2026-10-21 shows how to upgrade.
  • We’ve released new versions of the client SDKs and the ant CLI that send API version 2026-10-21 by default: Python SDK 2.0.0, TypeScript SDK 1.0.0, C# SDK 13.0.0, Go SDK 2.0.0, Java SDK 3.0.0, PHP SDK 1.0.0, Ruby SDK 2.0.0, and ant CLI 2.0.0. See Switch to 2026-10-21.
  • The new SDK and CLI versions also have breaking changes that don’t depend on the API version, and they are licensed under Apache 2.0 instead of the MIT License. See SDK and CLI changes.
  • We’ve added the enforcement_status and enforcement_actions fields to user profiles, so you can see whether Anthropic has restricted or banned one of your end customers. To find the profiles that have an open restriction or ban, list your profiles with the new enforcement_status[] filter. See Check whether Anthropic has restricted or banned a profile.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — August 18, 2026
item.description: • Workbench is now playground in the Claude Console. Playground supports every Messages API parameter and includes templates that demonstrate API features such as code execution and web search. It shows the full SDK request and the API response for each run, to help you understand the API and build with it. For more, see the Claude Help Center or try it at platform.claude.com/playground.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — March 16, 2026
item.description: • We’ve launched the display field for extended thinking, letting you omit thinking content from responses for faster streaming. Set thinking.display: "omitted" to receive thinking blocks with an empty thinking field and the signature preserved for multi-turn continuity. Billing is unchanged. Learn more in Controlling thinking display.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — September 3, 2025
item.description: • We’ve launched support for citable documents in client-side tool results. Learn more in Handle tool calls.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — February 27, 2025
item.description:
• We’ve added URL source blocks for images and PDFs in the Messages API. You can now reference images and PDFs directly through a URL instead of having to base64-encode them. Learn more in Vision and PDF support.
  • We’ve added support for a none option to the tool_choice parameter in the Messages API that prevents Claude from calling any tools. Additionally, you’re no longer required to provide any tools when including tool_use and tool_result blocks.
  • We’ve launched an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, allowing you to test Claude models by changing only your API key, base URL, and model name in existing OpenAI integrations. This compatibility layer supports core chat completions functionality. Learn more in OpenAI SDK compatibility.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — July 15, 2024
item.description: • Generate outputs up to 8,192 tokens in length from Claude Sonnet 3.5 with the new anthropic-beta: max-tokens-3-5-sonnet-2024-07-15 header.
